name: EJScreen (restored)
description: Unofficial restored copy of the EPA's environmental justice screening tool, taken offline by the agency in 2025. Maps pollution burden and demographic indicators by census block group across the US, rebuilt from public data.
embedNote: Site sends a frame-blocking header, so the preview opens in a new tab

Data Licensing.note: Rebuilt from EPA public domain data

Technical Accessibility.note: Web map with downloads; same-origin framing only

Infrastructure.note: Volunteer coalition hosting; reproducible from the pipeline
